description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#1052: an uncaught thrown non-Error object prints Node 22.22.0's two layouts: thrown by the -e, -p or piped stdin script itself, the arrow comes first with an empty line after it and no leading one, or, when the object's stack is a string, goes into that stack, which is all that is printed; thrown by a later callback (a timer, an immediate, a tick) or a file, a leading empty line, the arrow and the object; never the --trace-uncaught hint, which a primitive keeps; an ES module entry's from run_main, and an ES module file's timer named by its file: URL (stderr as JSON strings)
